## [0.1.2] — 2026-08-27

### EN
- Fixed shared-direct permission corruption: registry updates rewrite the file in place (`cat >`) instead of `mv`, keeping inode/owner/group so fellow dshports members keep write access.
- `open` / `up --open` use the platform browser launcher and report spawn failures; `/remote up <host> --open` honors the flag.
- Heartbeats skip a beat while the previous round-trip is still in flight.
- CI workflow runs the test suite on every push/PR (Node 22.19).

### 中文
- 修复 shared-direct 权限破坏:登记表更新由 `mv` 改为 `cat >` 原地改写,保留 inode/属主/组,dshports 组其他成员的写入不再失效。
- `open` / `up --open` 按平台选浏览器启动器并上报失败;`/remote up <host> --open` 正确解析。
- 心跳上一轮未返回时自动跳过,不再并发堆积。
- 新增 CI 工作流,每次 push/PR 跑测试(Node 22.19)。
